name: Image Input
summary: Loads or uploads an image into the workflow as a base64 string. Serves as the starting point for image processing pipelines.

outputs.description: The loaded image as base64 string with metadata (filename, width, height)

executionNotes: This is a data source node with no upstream dependencies. Users upload or paste image data directly. The node stores the image in base64 format along with filename and dimensions (width, height).

exampleConnections.scenario: Use an uploaded image as source for AI-powered image generation or transformation
Split a reference image into a grid for parallel processing
